steps.name: public-content-approval-and-privacy-audit
steps.summary: 2026-07-27 public defaults were approved: unapproved organization names and internal workflows will be generalized, detailed metrics require evidence, the profile photo and GitHub are public, email/contact form and light theme are excluded, and /portfolio is canonical. All 2 PDF pages and the public UI data were audited; the PDF download remains deferred until organization identifiers and resume filenames are aligned in Step 5.

steps.name: shared-shell-accessibility-baseline
steps.summary: Added a keyboard-visible skip link and focusable main target, made Escape close mobile navigation and restore focus, simplified shared responsive widths, and removed the unapproved ThemeToggle and light-theme overrides. Focused RED/GREEN tests, the full test/lint/typecheck/build gates, and Chrome checks at 320/390/768/1440 px passed without horizontal overflow.

steps.name: home-evidence-first-simplification
steps.summary: Replaced the hard-coded project count, skill radar, rotating roles, and decorative status dashboard with projects.length, one representative project from the public collection, and a concise current focus. Home remains a Server Component, links to Portfolio, Resume, the approved public GitHub, and Blog without querying the Blog database, and exposes no email. Focused RED/GREEN, full test/lint/typecheck/build gates, and Chrome checks at 320/390/768/1440 px passed without horizontal overflow.
